Atari Lynx is a handheld game console developed by Atari Corporation and Epyx.
First released in the United States in September 1989 and discontinued in 1996.
It launched at $179.99 in the US.
About 5 million units were sold.
Its library has 71 games.
It followed the Atari XEGS and was succeeded by the Atari Lynx II.
Processors include the WDC 65C02.
